ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca (Aquatic Panda / Charcoal Typhoon) web-shell post-exploitation: IIS/Tomcat/Exchange worker spawning recon + LSASS dump
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Earth Lusca initial-access chain — exploitation of a public-facing app (ProxyLogon/ProxyShell, Log4Shell, Confluence, GitLab) followed by a web shell (China Chopper, Behinder, AntSword) running OS recon and credential theft under the web-server worker process. Earth Lusca was one of the primary CN clusters tracked by CrowdStrike (Aquatic Panda) for Log4j-driven web-shell deployment against academic, government and telecom targets in 2021-2024.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_name) as child values(Processes.process_id) as pid from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat*.exe","javaw.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","powershell_ise.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | eval is_lsass_dump=if(match(process,"(?i)(comsvcs\.dll.*MiniDump|procdump|sqldumper|rdrleakdiag.*\/dump|lsass)"),1,0) | eval is_recon=if(match(process_name,"(?i)(whoami|systeminfo|ipconfig|net1?\.exe|nltest|quser|tasklist)"),1,0) | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(process_name) as child_chain values(process) as cmdlines sum(is_recon) as recon_count max(is_lsass_dump) as lsass_dump_seen dc(process_name) as distinct_children by host user parent_process_name | where distinct_children >= 2 AND (recon_count >= 2 OR lsass_dump_seen=1) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WebServerParents = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","javaw.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe"]);
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","hostname.exe"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","mshta.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (WebServerParents)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins) or FileName in~ (LolBins)
| extend IsLsassDump = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("comsvcs.dll","MiniDump","procdump","sqldumper","rdrleakdiag","lsass")
| extend IsRecon = FileName in~ (ReconBins)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(FileName),
            ChildChain = make_set(FileName, 16),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            ReconCount = countif(IsRecon),
            LsassDumpSeen = max(IsLsassDump)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where DistinctChildren >= 2 and (ReconCount >= 2 or LsassDumpSeen == 1)
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;

let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","hostname.exe"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","mshta.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (WebServerParents)
| where ChildName in (ReconBins) or ChildName in (LolBins)
| extend IsLsassDump = TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("comsvcs.dll","MiniDump","procdump","sqldumper","rdrleakdiag","lsass")
| extend IsRecon = ChildName in (ReconBins)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(ChildName),
            ChildChain = make_set(ChildName, 16),
            SampleCmds = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 8),
            ReconCount = countif(IsRecon),
            LsassDumpSeen = max(IsLsassDump)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentName
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where DistinctChildren >= 2 and (ReconCount >= 2 or LsassDumpSeen == 1)
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Earth Lusca Web Shell Post-Exploitation - Web Server Worker Spawning Recon or LSASS Dump
id: 6c2f9e3a-2b6e-4d2a-9e3b-9c8a0c1d7f11
status: experimental
description: Detects web-server worker processes (w3wp.exe, tomcat, java, nginx) spawning OS recon LOLBins or LSASS-dumping commands, characteristic of Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda China Chopper / Behinder web-shell post-exploitation.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/a/earth-lusca-sophisticated-infrastructure-varied-tools-techniques.html
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - g0143
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_webserver:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
  child_recon_or_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\quser.exe'
      - '\tasklist.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  lsass_dump_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'comsvcs.dll'
      - 'MiniDump'
      - 'procdump'
      - 'sqldumper'
      - 'rdrleakdiag'
      - 'lsass'
  condition: parent_webserver and (child_recon_or_lolbin or lsass_dump_cmdline)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate web-app deployment / monitoring scripts that shell out from the worker process (rare; allowlist by SHA256 if present).
level: high
ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\w3wp.exe OR *\W3WP.EXE OR *\httpd.exe OR *\HTTPD.EXE OR *	omcat.exe OR *\Tomcat.exe OR *	omcat9.exe OR *\javaw.exe OR *\java.exe OR *
ginx.exe OR *\NGINX.EXE) AND (@Image:(*\whoami.exe OR *\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\systeminfo.exe OR *\SystemInfo.exe OR *\ipconfig.exe OR *\IpConfig.exe OR *
et.exe OR *\NET.EXE OR *
et1.exe OR *
ltest.exe OR *\quser.exe OR *	asklist.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *undll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR * itsadmin.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *MiniDump* OR *procdump* OR *sqldumper* OR *rdrleakdiag* OR *lsass*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|httpd|tomcat9?|javaw?|nginx)\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(whoami|systeminfo|ipconfig|net1?|nltest|quser|tasklist|cmd|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|certutil|bitsadmin|mshta)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)(comsvcs\\.dll|MiniDump|procdump|sqldumper|rdrleakdiag|lsass)", field=CommandLine))
| ChildName := lower(ImageFileName)
| IsLsassDump := if(regex("(?i)(comsvcs\\.dll|MiniDump|procdump|sqldumper|rdrleakdiag|lsass)", field=CommandLine), then=1, else=0)
| IsRecon := if(regex("(?i)\\\\(whoami|systeminfo|ipconfig|net1?|nltest|quser|tasklist)\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName), then=1, else=0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=ChildEvents), count(field=ChildName, distinct=true, as=DistinctChildren), max(IsLsassDump, as=LsassDumpSeen), sum(IsRecon, as=ReconCount), collect([ChildName, CommandLine])])
| DistinctChildren >= 2
| (ReconCount >= 2 OR LsassDumpSeen = 1)
| sort(field=ReconCount, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Earth Lusca (MITRE G0143, CrowdStrike Aquatic Panda, Microsoft Charcoal Typhoon) is documented by Trend Micro and CrowdStrike as a top-tier exploiter of Log4Shell, ProxyLogon/ProxyShell, GitLab and Confluence — chaining T1190 to T1505.003 web shells (China Chopper, Behinder, AntSword) then T1003.001 LSASS dumping (often via the comsvcs.dll LOLBin MiniDump trick). The parent process is the giveaway

ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca DLL side-loading via signed third-party binary running from non-standard path (ShadowPad / Cobalt Strike loader)
ucs.description: Hunts Earth Lusca's signature DLL side-loading: a legitimately-signed application (commonly from VMware, Microsoft, Kaspersky, NVIDIA, or various security products) is copied into an attacker-controlled directory together with a malicious DLL that the binary auto-loads from CWD. This delivers ShadowPad, Winnti, FunnySwitch and Cobalt Strike loaders — a hallmark of Aquatic Panda / Bronze University reporting from 2021 onward.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_path) as path values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vmnat.exe","vmware-vmx.exe","avp.exe","avpui.exe","OneDrive.exe","OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","nvSCPAPISvr.exe","BgaSnap.exe","hkcmd.exe","AppLaunch.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","msdtc.exe","DTHelper.exe","cookie_exporter.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval out_of_band=if(match(path,"(?i)\\\\(ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|Intel|Recovery|\\$Recycle\\.Bin)\\\\"),1,0) | eval in_program_files=if(match(path,"(?i)\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\"),1,0) | where out_of_band=1 AND in_program_files=0 | join type=left dest [ | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dat") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename file_path as dll_path file_name as dll_name | eval sib_path=replace(dll_path,"[^\\\\]+$","")] | where like(sib_path,replace(path,"[^\\\\]+$","")) | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(path) as signed_binary_path values(cmdline) as cmdlines values(dll_name) as sideloaded_dll values(parent_process_name) as parent by dest user process_name | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["vmnat.exe","vmware-vmx.exe","avp.exe","avpui.exe","onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","googleupdate.exe","nvscpapisvr.exe","bgasnap.exe","hkcmd.exe","applaunch.exe","runtimebroker.exe","msdtc.exe","dthelper.exe","cookie_exporter.exe","nv.exe"]);
let OutOfBand = @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Windows\\Temp|PerfLogs|Intel|Recovery|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\";
let SignedProcs =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | extend FolderLow = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where FolderLow matches regex OutOfBand
    | where FolderLow !contains @"\program files\" and FolderLow !contains @"\program files (x86)\"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256;
let SideloadDirs = SignedProcs
    | extend Dir = strcat(tolower(substring(FolderPath, 0, strlen(FolderPath) - strlen(FileName))))
    | project DeviceId, Dir, FileName, ProcTime = Timestamp;
let SuspectDlls =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".dat"
    | extend DllDir = tolower(substring(FolderPath, 0, strlen(FolderPath) - strlen(FileName)))
    | project DllTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DllName = FileName, DllDir, DllSha256 = SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
SideloadDirs
| join kind=inner SuspectDlls on DeviceId, $left.Dir == $right.DllDir
| where DllTime between (ProcTime - 1d .. ProcTime + 5m)
| join kind=inner SignedProcs on DeviceId, $left.FileName == $right.FileName
| project ProcTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SignedBinary = FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          SideloadedDll = DllName, DllSha256, DllDir, ProcessCommandLine, DllDroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
) on DeviceName
| order by ProcTime desc

let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["vmnat.exe","vmware-vmx.exe","avp.exe","avpui.exe","onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","googleupdate.exe","nvscpapisvr.exe","bgasnap.exe","hkcmd.exe","applaunch.exe","runtimebroker.exe","msdtc.exe","dthelper.exe","cookie_exporter.exe"]);
let OutOfBand = @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Windows\\Temp|PerfLogs|Intel|Recovery|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\";
let SignedProcs =

    | extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend FolderLow = tolower(TargetProcessName)

    | where FolderLow !contains @"\program files\" and FolderLow !contains @"\program files (x86)\"
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ChildName, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let SuspectDlls =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("dll","dat")
    | extend DllDir = tolower(substring(TargetFilePath, 0, strlen(TargetFilePath) - strlen(TargetFileName)))
    | project DllTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, DllDir, TargetFileSHA256;
SignedProcs
| extend Dir = tolower(substring(TargetProcessName, 0, strlen(TargetProcessName) - strlen(ChildName)))
| join kind=inner SuspectDlls on DvcHostname, $left.Dir == $right.DllDir
| where DllTime between (TimeGenerated - 1d .. TimeGenerated + 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, SignedBinary = ChildName, TargetProcessName, SHA256,
          SideloadedDll = TargetFileName, DllSha256 = TargetFileSHA256, DllDir, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\ProgramData\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\Intel\* OR *\Recovery\*) AND @Image:(*\vmnat.exe OR *\VMNAT.EXE OR *\vmware-vmx.exe OR *\avp.exe OR *\AVP.EXE OR *\avpui.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe OR *\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe OR *\nvSCPAPISvr.exe OR *\nvscpapisvr.exe OR *\BgaSnap.exe OR *\hkcmd.exe OR *\AppLaunch.exe OR *\RuntimeBroker.exe OR *\msdtc.exe OR *\MSDTC.EXE OR *\DTHelper.exe OR *\dthelper.exe OR *\cookie_exporter.exe) AND -@Image:(*\Program?Files\* OR *\Program?Files?(x86)\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vmnat|vmware-vmx|avp|avpui|OneDrive|OneDriveStandaloneUpdater|GoogleUpdate|nvSCPAPISvr|BgaSnap|hkcmd|AppLaunch|RuntimeBroker|msdtc|DTHelper|cookie_exporter)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|Intel|Recovery|\\$Recycle\\.Bin)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("(?i)\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| ProcDir := replace("[^\\\\]+$", with="", field=ImageFileName)
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)\\.(dll|dat)$", field=TargetFileName) | DllDir := replace("[^\\\\]+$", with="", field=TargetFileName)}, field=[aid, ProcDir], key=[aid, DllDir], include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, _time])
| rename(field=TargetFileName, as=SideloadedDll)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SideloadedDll], function=[min(_time, as=FirstSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ContextImageFileName])])
| sort(field=FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading via legitimate signed binaries is THE Earth Lusca delivery primitive — Trend Micro's 2022 / 2024 reporting documents it as the consistent loader pattern for ShadowPad, Winnti and Cobalt Strike across the group's intrusions in Hong Kong, Taiwan, the Philippines and Western targets.
